about: A09 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a09beach
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. On a windswept sunrise beach a stylized 3D animated photographer looks up at gathering clouds while her client holds up her phone. A glowing pale lavender calendar page flutters in on a ribbon of sparkle dust, flips over in the air and settles neatly onto a new date. The photographer smiles with relief, the clouds part, and the client gives a thumbs up. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm light, Same faces, same clothes, same place, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.

shots.name: a09m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a09diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame; no zoom, no cuts. On a small diorama of a sunrise beach on a pale lavender backdrop, the tiny stylized 3D animated photographer smiles up at a small glowing lavender calendar page that flips in the air above her, then gives a little happy nod. The backdrop stays clean pale lavender and the sand stays warm and vivid with strong contrast and crisp detail from the first frame to the last, no haze, no fog, no mist, no fade, no bloom. Same face, same clothes, nothing drifts.
